title: Implement the executable walking skeleton

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Python tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest

verify.summary: Independent T3 functional verification passed all current-source gates and fresh isolated runtime, restart, persistence, idempotent-delete and owned-cleanup probes.

evidence_required: Redacted outputs and exit codes for Compose config/build, mypy, pytest and the isolated smoke command.
Effective topology evidence that one application image supplies all three roles and only the non-production HTTPS edge is host-published.
Empty-database Alembic/pgvector evidence using one Base/MetaData and no product tables.
Target-image OpenCV/InsightFace import and fake FaceEngine warmup/readiness evidence.
PostgreSQL/MinIO read-write-read-after-restart-delete and task-owned cleanup evidence.
Independent VERDICT: PASS, T3 semantic-pass evidence and the exact human checkpoint marker before closure.
purpose: Create the minimum reproducible application/runtime substrate required before any product feature can be tasked or implemented.
success_outcome: A fresh isolated checkout builds one image, invokes backend, BackgroundPhotoWorker and RealtimeFaceService roles, passes configured mypy/pytest, applies the one empty-database Alembic stream, keeps internal services private, and passes fake-engine, HTTPS, import, storage, restart and cleanup probes without product behavior.
anti_goals: Do not implement FT-001 through FT-012 behavior, product tables, endpoints, authentication or seed data.
Do not create empty serving_control, inventory, promo or diagnostics packages merely to mirror the future architecture.
Do not download or run a production face model, provision production TLS, deploy to production or add backup, broker, extra-worker or distributed machinery.

forbidden_scope: Product Photo, processing, Attempt, Promo/session, diagnostics, inventory and authentication behavior
Production deployment, production certificates and operator/default persistent-volume deletion
stop_conditions: The accepted one-release, capability-root, private-service or single-migration-stream architecture would need to change.
Passing the baseline would require a product schema, endpoint, state machine, auth flow or feature behavior.
The smoke proof cannot be isolated from existing operator/default Compose resources or requires mounting the host Docker socket.
A real model download/inference or another production-capable external side effect becomes necessary.

constraints: Use one installable Python release and one application image with separately invocable backend, background-worker and realtime roles.
The composition root owns settings, adapters, wiring and lifecycle only; create only roots used by the proof.
Use one PostgreSQL application schema, one SQLAlchemy Base/MetaData, one Alembic configuration and one linear migration stream.
Publish only the non-production HTTPS edge; PostgreSQL, MinIO, internal role ports and the Docker API remain private.
Exact module filenames, edge technology, test certificate method, dependency versions, bucket names and migration revision filename remain implementation discretion.
invariants: No Foundation migration creates Product, Attempt, Promo/session, evidence, auth or purge tables.
The realtime bootstrap uses an explicit fake FaceEngine and never downloads or runs a production model.
The smoke harness uses a unique Compose project and deletes only its own probe data and resources.
Any dependency, migration, warmup, readiness, topology, storage, restart or cleanup failure is visible and exits non-zero.
verification_targets: One image supplies three healthy role entrypoints and imports OpenCV plus InsightFace.
An empty database reaches the single current Alembic head with pgvector available and no product tables.
HTTPS readiness, private-service topology, PostgreSQL/MinIO convergence, persistence across restart and owned cleanup pass from a fresh isolated state.
